name: The Eleven
title: The Apostles After Judas' Fall
summary: The Eleven were the apostles who remained after Judas Iscariot had betrayed Jesus and fallen away. It was to them that the risen Jesus appeared, and they received the mission command before a new apostle was chosen in Judas' place.

keyEvents.title: Meeting the Risen One
keyEvents.description: The Eleven and those with them heard the testimony of the resurrection, and Jesus appeared to them.
